newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice falls sharply on speculative selling.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice falls sharply on speculative selling.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended sharply lower on Friday, hit by aggressive speculative selling and little demand from the cash market, traders said.
"The specs came in here about midday, right when corn and wheat were falling," a trader said. "Stops were hit on pretty good volume. Funds are getting shorter and shorter."
Floor sources said cash demand was quiet with little domestic or export business in the works.
"There's no supply but there's no demand," a trader said.
Rain delays in key Arkansas and Texas planting areas continued to be of concern to the market.
Those concerns modified losses in the new crop months.
Rice ended 25-1/2 to six cents per cwt lower with July down 25-1/2 at $11.06-1/2.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 700 lots, compared with Thursday's actual volume of 353 lots.
